collections.title: Planted Aquarium Lighting
collections.body_html: Full-spectrum LED aquarium lights, planted tank LED bars, nano grow lights and timer controllers. Chosen on PAR and spectrum, not marketing.

collections.title: Aquarium CO2 Systems
collections.body_html: Aquarium CO2 regulators, dual-gauge solenoid regulators, inline diffusers, drop checkers and bubble counters. Everything for planted-tank CO2 injection except the gas cylinder.

collections.title: Aquascaping Tools & Equipment
collections.body_html: Aquascaping tools, tank maintenance gear and equipment: stainless tweezers and scissors, magnetic glass cleaners, gravel cleaners and programmable feeders.

collections.title: Aquarium Substrate & Hardscape
collections.body_html: Active aqua soil substrate for planted tanks, fine white aquarium sand, seiryu stone hardscape and spider wood driftwood.

collections.title: Aquarium Water Test Kits
collections.body_html: Freshwater aquarium water test kits: liquid master reagent kits, 8-in-1 test strips and digital pH / TDS meters. The three parameters that actually kill fish: ammonia, nitrite, pH.
